x: With two new faces competing for the first time, Paul Gerhard and Simon Simpson, we were much stronger and won 14 events in all. The confidence was flowing throughout the match which was a great change from previous years and the spirit and enthusiasm in the team was good to watch.

Again everybody performed really well but perhaps a special mention should be made of Simon Simpson who took everybody on in the 800m and tried to do the same in the 1,500m but was knocked over by someone three times his size when he was going really well.
We had a very good turn-out in the Colts race and everybody ran well, particularly newcomers S.Simpson, M.Blackmore, D.Ferrari, M.Kelsey, D.Turner and R.Mann.

Simon Simpson started the league season with a tremendous run in the Colts race. Gary Williscroft followed suit in the Boys race and John Searle and Mark Sinclair got the Youths off to a really fine start.
Simon Simpson ran on both days and had another great run. David North performed excellently in the Youths event, finishing 9th in a very high class field.

Simon Simpson and Ray McCann were very disappointed with the other Colts who didn't turn up and it showed in the way they ran. If only we had a dozen more like these two - their enthusiasm and willingness to compete on every occasion puts the rest of the Club to shame.
(We since hear that he has emigrated to Australia.) Colts: 1.S.Simpson 17:07; 2.R.McCann 19:28; 3.R.Mann; 4.K.Sexton. Boys: 1.G.Sexton 15:57; 2.M.Cannon 17:06; 3.A.Horton.

John Searle moved into the bronze medal position in the individual Youths league with Mark Sinclair and Mark Waller equal 8th. Colts: 11.M.Blackmore 12:41; 29.R.McCann 13:04; 33.S.Simpson 13:07; D.Turner dnf.
